findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the interior of the ice machine (baffle) to have a layer of pink mold. Discussed with PIC. PIC cleaned the machine during the inspection. Ensure the interior of the ice machine is routinely cleaned (wash, rinse, sanitize) and particular attention is paid to the baffle. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the interior baffle of the ice machine to have layer of black mold. Inspector showed PIC/CFPM. PIC began to wash, rinse, sanitize the interior basin of the ice machine. Discussed routine cleaning of the ice machine with PIC. Ensure a schedule is adhered to in order to prevent mold build-up. COS.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the following areas in need of repairs (no longer smooth, easily cleanable, non-absorbent):
1. Dish machine is new and needs re-caulked to the wall. Inspector showed PIC areas that need re-caulked.
2. The shelf under the dish machine area is heavily rusted. Inspector suggested replacing the shelving under the dish machine due to amount of rust present.
3. The edging of the hot holding steam table needs resealed. The wood is exposed and needs to be painted/sealed. 

Discussed repairs with PIC. PIC was in agreement to have maintenance staff correct these issues. Correct before next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. 

A large can of product is observed with multiple at or dents on the can rack. Can was discarded during the inspection to correct.
